title: Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta version reading: Pāli and Thanissaro English
question: What can be compared between a Pāli excerpt and a modern English translation of one discourse, and which differences must remain visible?
disclaimer: This is a language-version reading within one text, not a collation of Pāli manuscripts; “suffering / stress” records translator wording without declaring a single authorised rendering.
